claim: Patchline ships a real-time global hazard-prevalence map refreshed from public commits hourly. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate then re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the prevalence map claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make global-hazard-prevalence-map-gate`.
